senses.gloss:
Naiga
or Naigeya (Pariśiṣṭa). vedalakṣaṇa. anukramaṇī of Sv. in Naigeyaśākhā. Baroda 9915 (b). CLB. I. p. 30. Trav. Uni. 2915E (inc.).
See Naigeyārcika, Naigeyārṣadaivata etc.

Naigamābhidhāna
Q. by Rāyamukuṭa. See Nigamākhya.

Naigeya
BORI. 112 an. 113 of 1879-80. RASB. II. 1313 (a. index to Sv.). 1314 (Sv.).
--by Gobhila. Oudh III. 4. XIII. 26.

Naigeyaṛkṣudaivata
vedic. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 59 (2 mss.). See Naigeyapariśiṣṭa.

Naigeyapariśiṣṭa
or Naigeyānām ṛkṣu ārṣam or ºdaivatam. vedalakṣaṇa in 2 parts. on the seers an. deities of the Ṛks in Sv.
Adyar I. p. 50b. Adyar D. I. 888. BORI. 112 an. 113 of 1879-80. 43 of 1884-86. 47 of 1884-87. 63 of 1886-92. BORI. D. I. i. 148-52. L. 796. Oxf. 377b. 383b. Oxf. II. 857 (5). Peters. II. p. 180 (no. 7475). III. p. 385 (no. 43). IV. p. 3 (no. 58). Extr. p.. 4-6. Rgb. 47. Stein 5. Trav. Uni. 2915E.
Pt.. Naigeyaśākhānukramaṇi. ed. by S. R. Sehgal. Munshiram Manoharlal. Delhi, 1966.

Naigeyārcikānukrama
Pariśiṣṭa of Sv. Stein 5 (inc.).
C.. Naigeyapariśiṣṭa.
--by Ananta, son of Bhīma. Oxf. 378a. Oxf. II. 855 (16).

Naigeyārṣadaivata
Sv. alt. name of Naigeyapariśiṣṭa. BORI. D. I. i. 148. [Page227-b]
